feasibility: Limited positive feasibility for segmentation support from one manually approved helper image; not a validated multi-pose anatomical model.

assessment.conclusion: Limited positive feasibility for segmentation support from one manually approved helper image; not a validated multi-pose anatomical model.

findings.pose_compliance: Closer to uncrossed arms-down than a clear right-arm lift; visual acceptance does not validate target-pose compliance.
findings.arm_separation: One connected substantial source arm category becomes two image-space components in the selected pose. Both sleeve/hand regions are easier to distinguish.
findings.upper_arm_and_elbow: Character left arm (viewer right) has a more readable outer contour and sleeve bend. Much of character right upper arm remains occluded/unparsed; joints are not established.
findings.hands: Both hands and cuffs are visible at the sides, away from the source crossed-arm contact. SAM does not create hand/wrist subparts and finger anatomy is not independently verified.
findings.torso: Front clothing under the original crossed forearm is now illustrated continuously. Its folds, shape and shading are generated hypotheses, not recovered source pixels.
findings.draw_order: Reduced arm-to-arm contact helps coarse ownership. Depth and shoulder/torso draw-order boundaries remain uncertain.
findings.cross_pose: Only one auxiliary pose is approved. Limb-length consistency and correspondence across a helper-pose family are untested.

assessment.recommended_next_step: Review another complementary pose, then evaluate generic sided arm and cuff/hand proposals using approved images only. Do not transfer joints or generated pixels into the accepted rig automatically.
